title.narrative: Operation of the Specialized Hospital for Ophthalmology and Eye Surgery in Marib, Phase IV

description.narrative: Specialized eye disease treatment and localizing the service for 166,415 thousand beneficiaries

• Providing specialized medical care services for ophthalmology and eye surgery in Ma'rib Governorate and its districts free of charge, through continuing to provide specialized medical services and treat cases according to need, and continuing to localize a specialized reference medical service in ophthalmology and eye surgery in Ma'rib Governorate and its districts in support of the Yemeni Ministry of Public Health and Population.

• Securing the medical needs of eye patients. • Alleviating the suffering of eye patients. • Reducing travel abroad for treatment, which directly contributes to the economic stability of the country. • Localizing cadres and services in ophthalmology and eye surgery. • Improving and developing performance according to specialized standards for ophthalmology and eye surgery.
